The Business Creativity partner for the world's most disruptive enterprises
Outcreating
streaming experiences
LTM helped a leading OTT platform transform how it delivers
content worldwide- replacing unreliable testing with a 24×7 QA model
and smarter infrastructure. The result: 30% fasterreleases, 40% shorter
test cycles, 3× device coverage and 50% infrastructure savings.
Ensuring viewers never miss a moment.
Learn more
Outcreating
omnichannel commerce
LTM unified customer data, content, and inventory for
UK’s top electronics retailer on Salesforce - making
shopping simpler and more personal. Conversions
grew by 30–40%. Engagement surged to 8.5M weekly.
Customers found what they wanted, faster.
Learn more
Outcreating
instant payments
LTM rebuilt a global financial institution’s payment
backbone using Architecture-as-a-Service.
Payment processing speeds got boosted by
91%, while capacity scaled from 20 to 500
transactions per second.
Payments became instant globally.
Trust became stronger.
Learn more
Outcreating
business efficiency
LTM created an SAP S/4HANA roadmap for America’s leading
HVAC company, migrating over 80% of what were once
fragmented ERPs to the cloud. Decisions got faster.
Operations got leaner. Savings got bigger.
While millions of customers got more reliable comfort, every day.
Learn more
Outcreating
humanitarian aid
LTM brought Gen AI-powered operational intelligence to a global humanitarian
organization, accelerating decision-making by 40% during crisis responses.
We’re creating faster smiles, and a smoother transition to a healthier, peaceful future.
Learn more
Outcreating
energy security
LTM modernized core energy systems for a global energy giant
using Gen AI. Delivery accelerated by 30%, defects dropped by
20%, and logic extraction cycles were cut by 35%. Ensuring
faster releases, lower risk, and systems built to scale.
While helping meet the world’s energy demands.
Learn more
